Independent reproduction: python3 /workspace/reproduction/check.py 1; stdout /workspace/reproduction/1.txt. Exhaustive rank-profile deletion for layered sources through n=12, all permutations checked for pattern avoidance through n=7, and exact finite cut-covariance checks.
correctness.rationale: Directly in the layer composition, deleting in a part larger than one decreases its size by one, giving distinct vectors of unchanged part count. Deleting a singleton gives one fewer part; deleting two different singleton positions yields the same vector exactly when all parts from one to the other are singletons. Thus the statistic counts long parts plus runs of singleton parts. The two-component sequence GF gives the stated rational function; normalization is by 2^(n-1). A j-component sequence needs length at least j+floor(j/2); the minimal alternating construction can absorb any surplus, and at the maximum the slack is at most one. Separating the zero-slack placements and the one-unit surpluses gives the three residue counts, including n=1,2. Independent fair cuts give summands X_i(1-X_{i-1}X_{i+1}); summing the boundary and interior covariances gives 7(n-1)/64 for n>=5, with the small cases checked separately. Two gaps between retained blocks of size floor(n^(1/3)) make the block sums independent; the removed centered sum has variance o(n) by two-dependence, so the retained variance is asymptotic to 7n/64. The uniform block bound is o(sqrt(n)), giving Lindeberg and the claimed CLT.
residual_risks: The computation corroborates finite cases, not the infinite limit; the latter follows from the blocking argument. The statistic counts distinct standardized outputs, not deletion positions or an output distribution under a random deletion.

value.rationale: An all-length law for a natural hereditary source measures the spread of ambiguity after rank-order deletion, not merely the size of the language. It separates the typical layered volume near 3n/8 from nearly n for the unrestricted source, quantifies fluctuations and gives exact finite-block frequencies and extreme multiplicities. The result is useful even though it does not solve a code-packing problem.
residual_risks: Value is limited to this uniform class and one deletion; no code capacity, decoding benefit or multi-deletion result was established.
